content.json:
# SQL under one view
*What Azure Arc inventories and what Azure Monitor observes, side by side: the Arc-enabled SQL Server instance and its databases, then the real SQL workload on a monitored host, its lock-timeout incidents and the alert rule that watches them.*

## SQL at a glance
Two different kinds of evidence. **Arc inventory** is what Azure Arc registered. **Azure Monitor** is what a real SQL workload reports through the Azure Monitor Agent, with no Arc SQL involved.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| summarize Instances = count(), Versions = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.version)), ', '), Editions = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.edition)), ', '),
    Licences = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.licenseType)), ', '), Builds = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.currentVersion)), ', ')
| project Label = 'SQL instances', Value = tostring(Instances), Note = 'Arc-enabled, in scope', Order = 1
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
    | summarize Versions = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.version)), ', '), Builds = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.currentVersion)), ', ')
    | project Label = 'SQL version', Value = Versions, Note = strcat('build ', Builds), Order = 3)
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
    | summarize Editions = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.edition)), ', ')
    | project Label = 'Edition', Value = Editions, Note = 'as registered with Arc', Order = 4)
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
    | summarize Licences = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.licenseType)), ', ')
    | project Label = 'Licence', Value = Licences, Note = 'licence type in Arc', Order = 5)
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' and name =~ 'WindowsAgent.SqlServer'
    | summarize Modes = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(properties.settings.LicenseType)), ', ')
    | project Label = 'Arc SQL mode', Value = iff(isempty(Modes), 'Unknown', Modes), Note = 'LicenseOnly = inventory only', Order = 6)
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases'
    | extend InstanceId = tolower(substring(id, 0, indexof(tolower(id), '/databases/')))
    | join kind=inner (resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances' | project InstanceId = tolower(id)) on InstanceId
    | summarize Total = count(), SystemDbs = countif(name in~ ('master', 'model', 'msdb', 'tempdb'))
    | project Label = 'Databases', Value = tostring(Total), Note = strcat(Total - SystemDbs, ' user, ', SystemDbs, ' system'), Order = 2)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Arc inventory
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance in the subscriptions selected. An instance appears once the Arc SQL extension (WindowsAgent.SqlServer) is installed on a server and the instance registers.

content.title: Monitored SQL workload
content.noDataMessage: No ArcSqlEngineDemo events in the selected time range. The demo SQL worker writes them from its host through the Azure Monitor Agent.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules' and name startswith 'al-' and name endswith '-sql-lock-timeout'
| project Label = 'Alert rule', Value = iff(tostring(properties.enabled) =~ 'true', 'Enabled', 'Disabled'), Note = name, Order = 1
| union (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules' and name startswith 'al-' and name endswith '-sql-lock-timeout'
    | project Label = 'Severity', Value = strcat('Sev', tostring(properties.severity)), Note = strcat('checks every ', replace_string(replace_string(tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency), 'PT', ''), 'M', ' min')), Order = 2)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Alert rule
content.noDataMessage: No SQL lock-timeout alert rule (al-<prefix>-sql-lock-timeout) exists in the subscriptions selected. It is deployed separately, only when an incident rehearsal is approved.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend e = properties.essentials
| where tostring(e.alertRule) endswith '-sql-lock-timeout'
| extend Raised = todatetime(e.startDateTime), Condition = tostring(e.monitorCondition), AlertState = tostring(e.alertState), Sev = tostring(e.severity)
| summarize Fired = count(), arg_max(Raised, Condition, AlertState, Sev)
| extend RaisedMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), Raised)
| extend RaisedText = case(RaisedMin < 120, strcat(RaisedMin, ' min ago'), RaisedMin < 2880, strcat(toint(round(RaisedMin / 60.0, 0)), ' h ago'), strcat(toint(round(RaisedMin / 1440.0, 0)), ' d ago'))
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Label', 'Alerts raised', 'Value', tostring(Fired), 'Note', strcat('latest ', RaisedText), 'Order', 1),
    pack('Label', 'Latest alert', 'Value', Condition, 'Note', strcat(AlertState, ', ', Sev), 'Order', 2))
| mv-expand data
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = tostring(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note), Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label, Value, Note
content.title: Alerts
content.noDataMessage: No alert has been raised by a SQL lock-timeout rule in the subscriptions selected. The rule only fires when a lock-timeout incident is rehearsed.

content.json:
## What Azure Arc inventories
> **Experimental configuration.** The instance below runs in a Hyper-V guest nested inside an Azure VM. Microsoft Learn lists SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines as **unsupported** for Arc-enabled SQL Server, so this shows Arc inventory behaviour only. It runs in licence-only mode: connection and inventory, not monitoring or assessment. The Defender column is the value Arc reports, which comes from subscription-level Defender plans; this lab makes no Defender for SQL claim.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend Host = tostring(split(tostring(properties.containerResourceId), '/')[8]), HostId = tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
| project Instance = name, Host, HostId, Version = tostring(properties.version), Edition = tostring(properties.edition), Licence = tostring(properties.licenseType),
    Status = tostring(properties.status), Defender = tostring(properties.azureDefenderStatus), LastInventory = todatetime(properties.lastInventoryUploadTime)
| join kind=leftouter (resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' and name =~ 'WindowsAgent.SqlServer'
    | project HostId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/extensions/')[0])), ArcSqlMode = tostring(properties.settings.LicenseType)) on HostId
| project Instance, Host, Version, Edition, Licence, ArcSqlMode, Status, Defender, LastInventory
| order by Host asc, Instance asc
content.title: SQL Server instances registered with Arc
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance in the subscriptions selected. An instance appears once the Arc SQL extension (WindowsAgent.SqlServer) is installed and the instance registers.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases'
| extend InstanceId = tolower(substring(id, 0, indexof(tolower(id), '/databases/')))
| join kind=inner (resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances' | project InstanceId = tolower(id), Instance = name) on InstanceId
| project Instance, Database = name, Kind = iff(name in~ ('master', 'model', 'msdb', 'tempdb'), 'System', 'User'), State = tostring(properties.state), SizeMB = round(todouble(properties.sizeMB), 1),
    Recovery = tostring(properties.recoveryMode), CompatibilityLevel = toint(properties.compatibilityLevel)
| order by Instance asc, Kind desc, Database asc
content.title: Databases discovered by Arc
content.noDataMessage: No databases to list because no Arc-enabled SQL Server instance is registered in the subscriptions selected.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend edition = tostring(properties.edition)
| summarize InstanceCount = count() by edition
| order by InstanceCount desc
| project Label = iff(isempty(edition), 'Unknown', edition), Value = tostring(InstanceCount), Note = iff(InstanceCount == 1, 'instance with this edition', 'instances with this edition')
content.title: Edition mix
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance in the subscriptions selected, so there is no mix to show.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend version = tostring(properties.version)
| extend versionMajor = case(
    version startswith '10.', 'SQL 2008/R2',
    version startswith '11.', 'SQL 2012',
    version startswith '12.', 'SQL 2014',
    version startswith '13.', 'SQL 2016',
    version startswith '14.', 'SQL 2017',
    version startswith '15.', 'SQL 2019',
    version startswith '16.', 'SQL 2022',
    version has '2022', 'SQL 2022',
    version has '2019', 'SQL 2019',
    version has '2017', 'SQL 2017',
    version has '2016', 'SQL 2016',
    version has '2014', 'SQL 2014',
    version has '2012', 'SQL 2012',
    version has '2008', 'SQL 2008/R2',
    'Unknown'
)
| summarize InstanceCount = count() by versionMajor
| order by versionMajor asc
| project Label = versionMajor, Value = tostring(InstanceCount), Note = iff(InstanceCount == 1, 'instance on this version', 'instances on this version')
content.title: Version mix
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance in the subscriptions selected, so there is no mix to show.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend licenseType = tostring(properties.licenseType)
| extend licenseDisplay = case(
    licenseType =~ 'PAYG', 'Pay-as-you-go',
    licenseType =~ 'Paid', 'Perpetual',
    licenseType =~ 'LicenseOnly', 'Hybrid Benefit',
    licenseType =~ 'Free', 'Free',
    'Unknown'
)
| summarize InstanceCount = count() by licenseDisplay
| order by InstanceCount desc
| project Label = licenseDisplay, Value = tostring(InstanceCount), Note = iff(InstanceCount == 1, 'instance with this licence', 'instances with this licence')
content.title: Licence mix
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instance in the subscriptions selected, so there is no mix to show.

content.json:
## What Azure Monitor observes
A real SQL Server workload on a monitored Windows host (not an Arc SQL instance). Its worker commits orders and reads them back; **event 6000** is written to the Application log after a healthy commit and read (about once a minute), **6201** is an actual lock timeout (SQL error 1222) and **6001** is the verified recovery. Each column is one time interval; a blank stretch means no events were recorded: the host was parked or the worker stopped.

content.title: Healthy commit events per minute
content.noDataMessage: No ArcSqlEngineDemo healthy-commit events (6000) in the selected time range. The demo SQL worker writes them from its host through the Azure Monitor Agent, about one a minute; none means the host was parked or the worker stopped.

content.title: Slowest commit and read per interval (ms)
content.noDataMessage: No ArcSqlEngineDemo healthy-commit events (6000) in the selected time range, so there is no latency to chart. Latency is the elapsedMs value in each event.

content.title: Lock timeouts and recoveries over time
content.noDataMessage: No lock-timeout (6201) or recovery (6001) events in the selected time range. That is the healthy case: incidents appear only when a rehearsal is run.

content.title: Lock-timeout incidents (SQL error 1222)
content.noDataMessage: No lock-timeout incidents (event 6201) in the selected time range. Incidents appear only when a rehearsal is run; widen the range to see earlier ones.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend e = properties.essentials
| where tostring(e.alertRule) endswith '-sql-lock-timeout'
| project Rule = tostring(split(tostring(e.alertRule), '/')[-1]), Severity = tostring(e.severity), Condition = tostring(e.monitorCondition), State = tostring(e.alertState),
    Raised = todatetime(e.startDateTime), Resolved = todatetime(e.monitorConditionResolvedDateTime)
| order by Raised desc
| take 15
content.title: Alerts raised by the lock-timeout rule
content.noDataMessage: No alerts have been raised by a SQL lock-timeout rule in the subscriptions selected. The rule only fires when a lock-timeout incident is rehearsed.
